profile_text.body:
Allient Inc is a public company headquartered in Williamsville, New York, with the ticker ALNT and SEC CIK 0000046129. The website associated with the company, alantra.com, describes Alantra as an international financial services firm with over 500 professionals across EMEA, the Americas, and Asia. According to that site text, the firm provides investment banking and alternative asset management services to corporations, family-owned companies, and institutional investors, and operates under a listed partnership model that the firm describes as combining stringent corporate governance with team autonomy.

The site text describes the firm's stated ambition as supporting clients with the best advice and products through what it calls an accountable and ethical approach to business. No AI products or MCP servers are listed for the company in the material provided.

The record also lists New York law exposure with a count of 448, and no cases.
